libbrillo: drop bootstat dep The bootstat code used to be part of libbrillo directly. When it was split out in CL:289240, a dep on bootstat was added to libbrillo to maintain the dep tree. But at this point, anything that uses bootstat should be depending on it directly (and a spot check of cs/ shows that is the case), so drop it from libbrillo so bootstat itself can depend on libbrillo :). Disable SortIncludes in .clang-format. Disable SortIncludes in the platform2 .clang-format file. clang-format does simple alphabetical sorting of #include lines, which conflicts with the fancier sorting used by cpplint.py, namely (quoting the comment from CanonicalizeAlphabeticalOrder): - replaces "-" with "_" so they both cmp the same. - removes '-inl' since we don't require them to be after the main header. - lowercase everything, just in case. BUG=chromium:767348 TEST=ran clang-format on power_manager/ and checked that it didn't reorder linux/i2c.h and linux/i2c-dev.h in powerd/system/display/external_display.cc Change-Id: I1ae5f42948f13d9a0c5157c8bfcc924566010b1f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/703985 Commit-Ready: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Luis Hector Chavez <lhchavez@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
